# forumulate_connector (Resource)

A chat or AI product connected to one space (Intercom, Zendesk, a custom provider...): installed with its `config`, optionally embedded on the reader and/or given read access to the space's knowledge base. `GET /orgs/{orgId}/connector-providers` lists the providers and the config fields each needs. For the organization-level e-signature, meeting and wallet connectors see `forumulate_service_connector`.

`config` is sensitive and write-only: the API reports only which fields are set (`configured_fields`) and which are still missing (`missing_fields`), so a changed secret cannot be detected. With `mint_token = true` the connector gets an access token for the product to read the knowledge base with; it is shown once and kept, sensitive, in `token`. Change `token_rotation` to mint a new one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "intercom_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Connect a chat product to a docs space: embed its widget on the reader and
# let it read the space's knowledge base.
resource "forumulate_connector" "intercom" {
  space_id    = forumulate_space.docs.id
  provider_id = "intercom"

  # Sensitive and write-only: the API reports which fields are set, not their values.
  config = {
    workspaceId = "abc123"
    accessToken = var.intercom_token
  }

  embed_enabled     = true
  knowledge_enabled = true
  knowledge_scopes  = ["search", "ask", "llms"]

  appearance = {
    primary_color = "#0b835b"
    color_scheme  = "system"
    position      = "right"
    greeting      = "Questions? Ask us."
  }

  # An access token for the product to read the knowledge base with, shown once.
  mint_token = true
}

output "intercom_knowledge_token" {
  value     = forumulate_connector.intercom.token
  sensitive = true
}

output "intercom_missing_fields" {
  value = forumulate_connector.intercom.missing_fields
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) The provider (2 to 70 characters), such as `intercom`; see `GET /orgs/{orgId}/connector-providers`. Changing it replaces the connector.
- `space_id` (String) The space (its id or slug). Changing it replaces the connector.

### Optional

- `appearance` (Attributes) How the embedded widget looks, for the providers that support it. Only the attributes you set are managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appearance))
- `config` (Map of String, Sensitive) The provider's configuration fields by key, each up to 2000 characters. Sensitive and write-only; a key you remove is cleared.
- `embed_enabled` (Boolean) Load the provider's widget on the reader. Defaults to off.
- `external_ref` (String) Your own reference, fixed at creation.
- `knowledge_enabled` (Boolean) Let the provider read the space's knowledge base (see `knowledge_scopes`). Defaults to off.
- `knowledge_scopes` (Set of String) What the provider may use of the knowledge base: any of `chunks`, `search`, `ask`, `llms`, `questions`, `suggestions`.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Free-form tags. Replaced whole when changed. Not returned on a read, so drift is not detected.
- `mint_token` (Boolean) Mint an access token for the connected product. Turning it off revokes the token.
- `token_rotation` (String) Any string; change it to mint a new token (the old one stops working). Only meaningful with `mint_token`.

### Read-Only

- `configured_fields` (Set of String) The names of the config fields that have a stored value.
- `id` (String) The connector's id (a UUID).
- `missing_fields` (Set of String) The names of required config fields still missing; the connector is incomplete until this is empty.
- `provider_name` (String) The provider's display name.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The access token, shown by the API once when minted. Sensitive.
- `token_prefix` (String) The first characters of the token, to recognise it in the console.

<a id="nestedatt--appearance"></a>
### Nested Schema for `appearance`

Optional:

- `color_scheme` (String) `system`, `light` or `dark`.
- `greeting` (String) The widget's greeting, up to 200 characters.
- `position` (String) `left` or `right`.
- `primary_color` (String) The widget colour, six-digit hex with the leading `#`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# config and token cannot be imported (the API never returns them): declare config and apply.
terraform import forumulate_connector.intercom docs/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
